params.body:
Replaces #391 (and the class fix it carried). #384 landed the relation picker on main with `<table class="ui-list ui-list-titled @if($isModal) ui-picker @endif">`, which leaves a trailing space in the class attribute of the relations page itself; `ListPageHeadersTest` (from #381) asserts the literal `<table class="ui-list ui-list-titled">` and fails on main because of it.

One line: the conditional becomes `{{ $isModal ? ' ui-picker' : '' }}`, so the page emits exactly the attribute the test expects and the picker in the modal still gets `ui-picker`. The test is unchanged.

Checked on current main: `ListPageHeadersTest`, `RelationPickerTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest` (21 tests, 748 assertions, OK). Everything else from #358 is already on main through #384; nothing to close but #391.
params.title: The relations page emits its list class without a trailing space (fixes ListPageHeadersTest on main)
